addressSelection.fieldType: STRUCT(freeform VARCHAR, locality VARCHAR, postcode VARCHAR, region VARCHAR, country VARCHAR)[]
addressSelection.geometryAuthority: Texas and county membership remain geometry-derived; address country/region are supporting evidence only.
addressSelection.methodExpression:
CASE
  WHEN list_extract(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), '')) = 'US' AND (NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), '') IS NOT NULL)), 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIRST_US_MEANINGFUL'
  WHEN list_extract(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), '')) = 'TX'), 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIRST_TX_REGION'
  WHEN list_extract(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), '') IS NOT NULL), 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIRST_FREEFORM'
  WHEN list_extract(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), '') IS NOT NULL), 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIRST_LOCALITY'
  WHEN list_extract(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL), 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIRST_NON_NULL'
  ELSE 'NO_USABLE_ADDRESS'
END
addressSelection.selectedAddressExpression:
COALESCE(
  list_extract(list_transform(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), '')) = 'US' AND (NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), '') IS NOT NULL)), a -> struct_pack(freeform := NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), ''), locality := NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), ''), postcode := NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), ''), region := NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), ''), country := NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), ''))), 1),
  list_extract(list_transform(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), '')) = 'TX'), a -> struct_pack(freeform := NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), ''), locality := NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), ''), postcode := NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), ''), region := NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), ''), country := NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), ''))), 1),
  list_extract(list_transform(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), '') IS NOT NULL), a -> struct_pack(freeform := NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), ''), locality := NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), ''), postcode := NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), ''), region := NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), ''), country := NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), ''))), 1),
  list_extract(list_transform(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), '') IS NOT NULL), a -> struct_pack(freeform := NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), ''), locality := NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), ''), postcode := NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), ''), region := NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), ''), country := NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), ''))), 1),
  list_extract(list_transform(list_filter(addresses, a -> a IS NOT NULL), a -> struct_pack(freeform := NULLIF(TRIM(a.freeform), ''), locality := NULLIF(TRIM(a.locality), ''), postcode := NULLIF(TRIM(a.postcode), ''), region := NULLIF(TRIM(a.region), ''), country := NULLIF(TRIM(a.country), ''))), 1)
)

expressions.addressQuality: CASE WHEN selected_address.freeform IS NOT NULL THEN 'FULL' WHEN selected_address.locality IS NOT NULL THEN 'LOCALITY_ONLY' WHEN selected_address.region IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGION_ONLY' ELSE 'MISSING' END
expressions.brandNameSource: CASE WHEN brand.names.primary IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRIMARY' WHEN map_extract_value(brand.names.common, 'en') IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMMON_EN' ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END
expressions.formattedAddress: CASE WHEN selected_address.freeform IS NOT NULL THEN selected_address.freeform WHEN selected_address.locality IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT_WS(', ', selected_address.locality, selected_address.region, selected_address.postcode, selected_address.country) WHEN selected_address.region IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT_WS(', ', selected_address.region, selected_address.country) ELSE NULL END
expressions.name: COALESCE(names.primary, map_extract_value(names.common, 'en'))::VARCHAR
expressions.nameSource: CASE WHEN names.primary IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRIMARY' WHEN map_extract_value(names.common, 'en') IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMMON_EN' ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END

notes: Addresses is an array/list of structs; select one element before field extraction.
Selection preserves source list order within each priority bucket and never uses address region/country as geometry authority.

verifiedSchema.addresses: STRUCT(freeform VARCHAR, locality VARCHAR, postcode VARCHAR, region VARCHAR, country VARCHAR)[]
verifiedSchema.brand: STRUCT(wikidata VARCHAR, names STRUCT(primary VARCHAR, common MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)))
